question: Can the learner-dependent numeral error be localized more specifically than post-layer answer-state transfer?

cases.assistantPrefixes: Use the already recorded actual common token prefix before each target fork, not a supplied corrected numeral

captureSemantics.attentionMinusInput: attention contribution after output projection, its output quantization and post-attention RMS norm
captureSemantics.mlpMinusAttention: MLP contribution after down projection, output quantization and post-FFN RMS norm
captureSemantics.outputMinusMlp: combined PLE and layer-scalar effect; not isolated PLE output
captureSemantics.patch: activation diagnostic, never automatically equivalent to a native weight update

screening.selectionRule: For each target choose at most one stage/site showing the largest positive donor-minus-zero fork-margin effect with a complete grammatical target phrase in the free continuation and preserved stated entity/price. If no site qualifies, stop that target.
screening.candidateSites: all three boundary stages at each of the three predeclared layers; exploratory search, not independent hypothesis tests

followup.norm: Each random perturbation is matched to the selected donor-contribution delta L2 norm
followup.upperTailTest: (1 + controls >= observed)/(1 + n), reported with floor 1/16; not a 0.05 significance test
followup.transfer: Apply the same donor-derived delta to the other target and preservation case without using their correct-context donor
followup.budget: At most one selected component per target; no expanding into a weight sweep

stop: No specific transferable rescue or failed numerical gate means no native weight repair; retain negative and invalidated evidence.
